setting: Setting "imageOutputPath" is set to /ai2html-output/ but Illustrator does not honor it. Illustrator writes the HTML and its images into a single output directory, and htmlOutputPath takes precedence when set. This value can move that one directory, but it never creates a separate image folder, so the emitted src is always a bare filename. Use imageSourcePath if your CMS serves the images from a different URL.
